confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and comparable cities, not from inspected live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain because prices vary by season and area (Cebu City versus the Mactan resort zone). Cocktail and wine anchors are partly based on the local beer relationship (about 4 times the draught beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Primarily calibrated to Manila, the closest Philippine comparable: restaurant and dorm levels set slightly below Manila, and hotel levels near Manila's range with an allowance for Mactan resort-zone premiums. Nha Trang and Koh Samui bracket the regional range for food and drink levels. Koh Samui's hotel prices are treated as a resort outlier and not used directly.
